# TPC-DS-OBT Q90

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  CAST(amc AS DECIMAL(15, 4)) / NULLIF(CAST(pmc AS DECIMAL(15, 4)), 0) AS am_pm_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS amc
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.sold_time_sk = sold_time_t_time_sk
      AND obt.ship_hdemo_sk = bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk
      AND obt.web_page_sk = web_page_wp_web_page_sk
      AND sold_time_t_hour BETWEEN 6 AND 6 + 1
      AND bill_hdemo_hd_dep_count = 0
      AND web_page_wp_char_count BETWEEN 5000 AND 5200
    )
    AND channel = 'web'
) AS am_count, (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS pmc
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.sold_time_sk = sold_time_t_time_sk
      AND obt.ship_hdemo_sk = bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk
      AND obt.web_page_sk = web_page_wp_web_page_sk
      AND sold_time_t_hour BETWEEN 13 AND 13 + 1
      AND bill_hdemo_hd_dep_count = 0
      AND web_page_wp_char_count BETWEEN 5000 AND 5200
    )
    AND channel = 'web'
) AS pt
ORDER BY
  am_pm_ratio
LIMIT 100
```
